correctness.rationale: Every independent nonnegative edge allocation satisfies two explicit singleton/pair Walsh Rayleigh bounds. A complete symmetric Walsh spectrum attains both bounds and reduces the unrestricted maximum to a verified two-variable linear frontier. Pointwise eigenvector equality enforces full rigidity in all price regimes, including the critical segment. Boundary dimensions \(d\ge4\), \(t>0\), budget normalization and asymptotic factor two are checked analytically; supplementary exact-rational computations executed on actual checker.

value.rationale: The theorem solves an infinite natural class of heterogeneous-price network design problems with a sharp dimension-scaled deletion threshold, all global optimizer geometry and no hidden asymmetric solutions. Its explicit asymptotic factor-two mixing gain from vanishing relative long-range expenditure reveals a non-obvious allocation benefit. These are structural optimization facts, not a table or routine reformulation.
